title: The Peninsula Golf Weekend: Two Nights, One Serious Round, Room for the Rest
dek: One round at St Andrews Beach, vineyard meals, an optional coastal walk and two nights on the ridge. For groups where not everyone plays.

bookingChecklist.item: Doot Doot Doot dinner and Montalto lunch

editorNote: One round at St Andrews Beach anchors Saturday. The rest of the weekend works around it: a ridge stay, vineyard meals and an optional coastal walk. Check the tee time before booking the meals, and allow enough time after the round to reach Montalto. The Sunday route goes north to Mornington before returning to Red Hill for the final cellar door; skip that last stop if you would rather keep heading home.

stops.note: Arrive Friday afternoon and settle into the ridge stay. Check the route to St Andrews Beach before setting tomorrow's departure time.
Friday dinner at the hotel restaurant. Sets the weekend up as an event rather than a golf grind.

Book a Saturday morning tee time and confirm the expected round duration with the course. Non-golfers can use the morning for Cape Schanck instead; agree on transport and the lunch meeting time first.
Meet for lunch after the round. Confirm the kitchen's service times and allow for the drive from the course when you book.
An optional coastal walk if the group has time and energy. Check park access and daylight before setting out; skip it after a late round or lunch.
Sunday brunch in Mornington. Check the current opening and kitchen hours before setting off.
One cellar door before the drive home. Serious pinot noir and chardonnay. The ridge sending you off.
